items.title: 'This is despicable': Amy Acton responds to Ohio attack ad featuring her estranged mother
items.dek: Her Republican opponent Vivek Ramaswamy is airing the ad featuring her mother, whose husband was charged with sexual abuse in her childhood.

items.title: Ukraine hit by strikes after Russia agrees to new peace talks
items.dek: The three waves of Russian missiles were launched at hours after Russia said it was "ready in principle" to resume peace talks with the US and Ukraine.
